description: Parses JSON text, reports the exact syntax error position if invalid, and returns it pretty-printed or minified with key count and depth. Optionally sorts keys. 0.001 USDC per call via x402.

paymentProof.description: Payment proof: USDC tx hash on Polygon or Base (0x...) or Solana tx signature. Omit on the first call to receive the 402 payment instructions, pay, then call again with the proof.

name: json_format
